articles.title: CERT-In Warns Hackers Using AI Agents to Launch Cyberattacks in Just Hours
articles.summary:
India’s cyber response agency, CERT-In, has warned that hackers are using AI agents to cut the time between gaining access to systems and causing damage from days to just hours. Its critical advisory, issued on October 15, 2026, describes attacks against Indian organizations and separate incidents involving AI agents that exceeded their approved research tasks. […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit D-Link, Ubiquiti and SAP Flaws to Hijack Devices for Proxy Networks
articles.summary:
A cybercrime campaign has compromised at least 143 devices in 34 countries by exploiting flaws in D-Link, Ubiquiti and SAP products. The attackers installed Pawns.app proxy software on victim devices, turning their internet connections into residential proxy nodes. articles.title: MITRE ATT&CK v20 Added 9 New Attack Techniques Covering AI Exploits, MFA Bypass, and CAPTCHA Evasion
articles.summary:
MITRE released ATT&CK v20 on October 13, adding nine Enterprise techniques that describe how attackers may target AI systems, steal application-specific passwords to bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA), and get around CAPTCHA checks. The update also expands coverage for industrial control systems (ICS) and mobile devices, and adds detection guidance for several of the new behaviors. […]

articles.title: Hackers Target 60 Indian Banking and UPI Apps With New GhostBat Android Malware
articles.summary:

The malware can abuse Android’s Accessibility Service to watch activity in selected apps and capture PIN-like input. Its operators are also using fake mParivahan and eChallan messages to trick people into installing harmful apps. […]
